integrity: A standalone Python verifier reproduces exact small-primorial calculations; the asymptotic proof is mathematical and has not received independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The result is an asymptotic for the normalized first-power recursive-divisor sum on primorials. Exact convolution-series identities are prior work. It assumes the classical effective prime-number theorem; no explicit error term or generalization beyond primorials is proved. The finite verification is not an infinite proof. Publication priority is subject to independent literature confirmation.
title: Square-root prime-scale growth of the recursive-divisor sum on primorials
